newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin down two cents to 14.27 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin down two cents to 14.27 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell two cents to 14.27 ringgit ($5.74) a kg after a fall on the London Metal Exchange on Friday, traders said.
They said support at the lower level from European and local buyers, however, limited the price drop.
"The market followed the LME but was supported by some demand at the lower level," said a trader.
Traders said there were bids for 59 tonnes, against offers of 73. Final turnover was 59 tonnes against 60 on Friday. The local premium against London was retained at $70 a tonne.
